normative_extracts.quote: Growing a Memory detaches the previous ArrayBuffer and creates a new ArrayBuffer backed by the enlarged memory.

pipeline_phases: Linear Memory Pointer Read/Write via TypedArray
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: JS invokes Wasm through a JIT trampoline that translates calling conventions; high-throughput code writes batches into WebAssembly.Memory via TypedArrays and refreshes views after memory.grow().

production_failures.symptom: Cached Uint8Array view silently reads zeros or throws after Wasm processes a large file
production_failures.root_cause: Wasm executed memory.grow(), detaching the previous ArrayBuffer while JS still held a reference to the old TypedArray.
production_failures.mitigation: Re-create TypedArray views from wasm.exports.memory.buffer after any Wasm call that can allocate.

production_failures.symptom: Wasm image or text processor runs slower than the pure JavaScript version it replaced
production_failures.root_cause: JS calls into Wasm inside a tight per-pixel or per-token loop, paying trampoline and UTF-8 TextEncoder overhead on every iteration.
production_failures.mitigation: Batch input buffers into linear memory once and invoke a single Wasm entry point per frame or chunk.
